- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **144** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 65a8eeb7d43d9248aa82ee698b78e87a2dce2ffc` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `dbd5ed99b94cf82671c2ee2278362df16ebd7455` — the merge of head `b8e0baa72a41607e5aa7bc27f1d3dfff96f44d68` into base `65a8eeb7d43d9248aa82ee698b78e87a2dce2ffc`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin dbd5ed99b94cf82671c2ee2278362df16ebd7455 && git checkout dbd5ed99b94cf82671c2ee2278362df16ebd7455
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 65a8eeb7d43d9248aa82ee698b78e87a2dce2ffc b8e0baa72a41607e5aa7bc27f1d3dfff96f44d68 && git checkout -B drift-repro 65a8eeb7d43d9248aa82ee698b78e87a2dce2ffc && git merge --no-ff b8e0baa72a41607e5aa7bc27f1d3dfff96f44d68

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 65a8eeb7d43d9248aa82ee698b78e87a2dce2ffc
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 65a8eeb7d43d9248aa82ee698b78e87a2dce2ffc` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

### ① Derived judgments

**Gate verdicts on this head (they ARE the verdicts).** 41 check-runs. Four `failure`: `Type Check · consumer gates` (step "Type check example apps": TS2741 `Property 'sharing_rule' is missing in type … but required in type 'Record of MetadataType to KindCoverage'`), its aggregate `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core (4/6)` (`examples/app-showcase` `pnpm run test` exit 1) and `Test Core (5/6)` (`packages/objectql` `pnpm run test` exit 1). `Test Core (3/6)` was `in_progress` and the `Test Core` aggregate `queued` at review time. Green: Check Changeset, Lint & Repo Gates and every Lint lane, Governed Surface Queue Guard, the three claim/closing guards, Spec property liveness, Build Core, Build Docs, Type Check · workspace / source gates / debt ledger, Test Core 1/6, 2/6, 6/6. Skipped by design on a `pull_request` event: Console Pin Gate, the Dogfood Regression Gate shards (`ci.yml:2037`), Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal, packed-tarball. The PR is `draft: true`, `mergeable_state: blocked`.

**(a) The door — closed, on both kernel shapes, with ADR-0112 codes.** `sharing_rule` enters `MetadataTypeSchema` (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts:190`) and `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` with `allowRuntimeCreate: false`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`, `supportsOverlay: false`, `domain: 'security'` (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts:1254`), the `capability` pair. `saveMetaItem` consults `isRuntimeCreateAllowed` on every topology (`protocol.ts:22911-22988`, the #5086 block, not behind `environmentId`): a new name takes `codeOnlyCreateError` → `403 NOT_CREATABLE`; a declared name is `isArtifactBacked` and `registryAllowsOverlay` is false → `codeOnlyOverrideError` → `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, hatch open or shut. `?mode=draft` goes through the same block. Both messages name the two sanctioned routes and not the hatch: `CODE_ONLY_TYPE_REMEDY` (`protocol.ts:17643`) and the regime-C branch (`protocol.ts:17690`, `17716`) read the new `PACKAGED_BASE_REGIME.sharing_rule` row (`packaged-base-regime.ts:205`: clone `POST /api/v1/sharing/rules`, switch `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/sharing_rule/:name`). The runtime pin `meta-sharing-rule-door.test.ts` drives the real `HttpDispatcher` → `handleMetadataRequest` → protocol → repository on both kernels and asserts code, both routes, length under 500, no row, nothing registered, plus `/meta/types` `allowRuntimeCreate: false` and a position control (200). Measured by the dev with an ablation (6 red / 4 green with the entry removed; the declared-name case stays green because the package door already sealed declared names). I accept the mechanism measurement: `refusePackagedBaseOverride` / `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false` refuse writes over a *packaged* name only, so they could not close a new name; the code-only pair is the fit.
- *Other doors.* The runtime meta domain accepts `PUT` only (`domains/meta.ts:1419`) plus `POST /_migrate-stored` (`:2072`, a rewrite of stored rows, not a create); REST `meta-item-write-routes.ts` calls the same `saveMetaItem`. `/meta/sharing_rules` (plural) folds to the singular and gets the same verdict. `rollbackMetaItem` / `revertCommit` / `promoteDraftForPublish` are covered by enrolling the type in `protocol.recovery-doors-emit-mutation.test.ts` and `protocol.code-only-types.test.ts`. `GET /meta/types` reads the registry arm (`getMetaTypes`, `protocol.ts:8873`), so it no longer advertises runtime create — pinned in the runtime test and `protocol.meta-types-mint-door-agreement.test.ts`.
- *System and package writers are not refused.* Declarations reach the registry through `registerApp` → `registerInMemory` (`app-plugin.ts:1464`, `['sharingRules','sharing_rule']`), never `saveMetaItem`; nothing in `packages/metadata`, `app-plugin.ts` or `registry.ts` reads `allowRuntimeCreate`. The organization door writes `sys_sharing_rule` rows. The ceremony's `door.save` writes `position`/`permission`, `view`, `email_template` and `conflict.type` (`organization-ownership-apply.ts:731,1560,1798,2019`) — see ③ for the `conflict.type` note. No 18.0 code path writes `sharing_rule` registry items through `saveMetaItem`; the dev's "none found" holds.
- *Residue.* `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=sharing_rule` still opens a NEW-name create (`isOverlayAllowed`, `protocol.ts:17551`) — unprescribed, dev-flagged, see ③. `DELETE /meta/sharing_rule/:name` of a stored residue row on an environment kernel answers `403 NOT_CREATABLE` without the hatch (`deleteMetaItem`, `protocol.ts:30580-30588`); a host-config kernel deletes it. Documented in the changeset.

**(b) 18.0 database — R2 holds; the harness proves nothing about this door.** The fixture's runtime sharing rule is a `sys_sharing_rule` row written through `POST /sharing/rules` (`populate-fixture.ts:171-182`, name `upgrade_harness_red_projects`; `manifest.json` lists `sys_sharing_rule`; `fixture-manifest.ts:46` reshapes it for step 5 only). It holds no `sys_metadata` row of type `sharing_rule`, so nothing in the fixture meets the closed door, and the PR touches no sharing-service code or table shape. For an 18.0 install that DOES hold such a row (only new names could exist: the package door already refused declared names on `main`): `loadMetaFromDb` hydrates every active environment row through `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` with no type-based skip (`protocol.ts:31239-31420`; the only withholding is `isUnservedSealedOverlay`, a row shadowing sealed managed content, which a new-name item is not), and `declaredRules` lists `registry.listItems('sharing_rule')` (`declared-sharing-rules.ts:269`), so the item is still read and enforced — no silent grant drop, no boot refusal, so no step-5 ceremony debt arises here. This is read off the code and the dev's save-time measurement on `main`; boot-time serving of a stored item at HEAD was not measured. The harness did not run on this head: CI runs the dogfood suite only off `pull_request` (`ci.yml:2037`), and the report lists no local run.

**(c) The Setup nav entry — present, i18n-labelled, right URL; gating is the sibling's, not `nav_permission_sets`'.** `sharing-plugin.ts:629`: `nav_declared_sharing_rules`, `type: 'url'`, `url: '/apps/setup/metadata/sharing_rule?scope=environment'`, `icon: 'package'`, `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']`, between `nav_sharing_rules` and `nav_record_shares` in `group_access_control` at priority 200. Labels in `en`/`zh-CN`/`ja-JP`/`es-ES` with source hashes (`a3371ec9975d5b0f`) in the three translated locales; the `sharing_rule` metadata-form display pair is in all four bundles and the echo-decision pins moved 28→29 / 673→674 with it. The dev's showcase boot measured `GET /meta/app/setup` serving the entry and its zh-CN label. Gating: `nav_permission_sets` (`security-plugin.ts:1590`) carries NO item-level `requiredPermissions`; Setup itself needs `setup.access` (`setup.app.ts:47`) and `group_access_control` (`:74`) has none. The new entry requires `manage_platform_settings`, the same as `nav_sharing_rules` / `nav_record_shares`, so a caller with `setup.access` alone sees Permission Sets but not Declared Sharing Rules. The card asked for `nav_permission_sets`' SHAPE (`type: 'url'`), which is met; the stricter gate is a reasoned choice (it matches the organization-rules sibling) — flagged in ③ for the seat, not a defect.

**(d) Item 3, answered (measure only, nothing built — correct).**
- *Ledger state on `/meta/sharing_rule` items.* The metadata protocol reads `sys_metadata_activation` for no type (zero references in `protocol.ts`; `/meta/position`, `/meta/permission`, `/meta/flow`, `/meta/action` carry no ledger reading either), and a meta item's `active` is the declaration's authored field (`declared-sharing-rules.ts:219`), measured `true` after a switch-off. Decorating one type's `/meta` items from a runtime table is a new cross-layer seam, so it fails the card's bar ("removes a client read without adding a new surface"). Not built — right. If the console's two reads become a measured cost, the shape is an admin read on the sharing door that lists switched-off declared rules with `active: false`, leaving `listRules` / `declaredRules()` (every enforcement path) untouched.
- *`GET /sharing/rules/:name` for a switched-off declared rule.* `getRule` (`sharing-rule-service.ts:1143-1150`) → `findRuleRow` (no `sys_sharing_rule` row) → `declaredRules` (`:994`), whose source applies `readSwitchedOffDeclaredRules` (`:1067-1095`, ledger `metadata_type: 'sharing_rule'`, `active: false`), so the rule is dropped and the route answers `404 RULE_NOT_FOUND` (dev measured on the showcase). The filter is right for enforcement. Recommendation concurred: a follow-up card for an admin-read projection with `active: false` on the by-name read only, as a `Clause-②: yes (widening)` change on an existing route, never reaching `declaredRules()`.

**(e) Complete feature — not on this head.** The server half is whole as a design: the door is closed and pinned on the HTTP transport, the listing agrees, the nav entry is served and opens the console's EXISTING generic Setup list of a registry type in environment scope (the route `nav_positions` / `nav_capabilities` / `nav_permission_sets` already use at the pinned console), so it is not dormant code waiting on objectui#13050 (which enriches that page with Disable/Enable/Clone). But ruling 6270035914 ("only complete features merge") and R1 of 6266750393 ("`main` stays releasable") are not met by a head whose type check and two test shards are red: the enum widening (`MetadataTypeSchema` gains `sharing_rule`) and the `domain: 'security'` registry entry each enrolled the type in a derived population the PR did not give a fixture, and the dev ran only `protocol-meta*` in objectql and no example-app suite. Blocking items below. The rendered console page was NOT MEASURED (no console build in the dev's container; Console Pin Gate skipped on the PR).

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` on PR body line 2 and in `.changeset/24550-sharing-rule-meta-door-closed.md`; the two agree. The claim carried `no (narrowing)`; the dev re-measured and flipped to `yes` because the diff also widens published surface (the `MetadataType` union gains a member, `META_URL_TO_SINGULAR` gains `sharing_rules`, the Setup nav payload gains an entry, the metadata-forms bundles gain a key) — I judge `yes` the honest arm. Levels: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` minor, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch — `yes` takes at least minor on a moved package: met. `(narrowing)` is BREAKING: the body carries the BREAKING banner, launch-window `minor` for a breaking change (the `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` guard is still in the tree and `Check Changeset` is green, so the window is open), FROM → TO for both narrowings (the PUT in publish and draft; the `/meta/types` advertisement), and the one-line fix verbatim: "author an organization rule, or clone the declared one", followed by the clone + switch recipe, the declaration channel, and the residue removal. ADR-0087: exactly one marker, `adr-0087: registered sharing-rule-runtime-create-withdrawn`, with the semantic entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.sharing-rule-runtime-create-withdrawn.ts` (surface, replacement, reason, acceptance criteria; naming follows `17.api-runtime-create-withdrawn.ts`); `check-adr-0087-registration` reads the narrowing arm and the dev reports it green at this head. Nit, not a gate matter: the changeset header reads `feat(…)!` while the PR title reads `fix(…)!`, and `platform-objects: patch` although its published `TranslationData` / metadata-forms payloads gain keys — moot under the `fixed` lockstep group. Reviewed-at-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (published schema paths in `packages/spec`, and the narrowing face as asked).

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **The hatch (dev open question 2, for the maintainer).** `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=sharing_rule` still opens a new-name runtime create, as for every code-only type; no refusal names it, and it is the only delete path for residue on an environment kernel. `sharing_rule` grants access, so the seat may want the maintainer's word on whether regime C seals the hatch for this type (a new carve-out in `isOverlayAllowed`) or keeps one hatch semantics. Not blocking.
2. **Clause-② arm flip** from the claim's `no (narrowing)` to the PR's `yes (narrowing)` — decided as measured; the seat should record it when adopting.
3. **Item 3b follow-up card** (admin-read projection of a switched-off declared rule, `yes (widening)`) and **item 3a's shape C** — noted, not filed.
4. **Harness not run on this head.** The dogfood suite is full-battery only (`ci.yml:2037`); the dev reported no local run of `upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts`. The diff touches no reshaped table and the fixture holds no `/meta`-written sharing rule, so R2 is not at risk from this diff, but "it must stay green if it has landed" is unmeasured until the merge-group or post-merge battery.
